description: Glutamine-brace retention and full motif census with permutation controls across canonical carriers and the MTCH clade
code:
import json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ALL=json.load(open('seqs.json')); AAC=ALL['AAC1_BOVIN']
M={}; 
for f in ['maps_batch1.json','maps_batch2.json']:
    for k,v in json.load(open(f)).items(): M[k]={int(p):r for p,r in v['map'].items()}
CANON=['AAC1_BOVIN','ANT1_HUMAN','AAC2_YEAST','UCP1_HUMAN','UCP2_HUMAN','UCP3_HUMAN','PIC_HUMAN',
       'CIC_HUMAN','CACT_HUMAN','ORNT1_HUMAN','GDC_HUMAN','DIC_HUMAN']
MTCH=[k for k in ALL if k.lower().startswith('mtch')]
VERT=[k for k in MTCH if k.startswith('MTCH2_') or k.startswith('MTCH1_')]
INV=[k for k in MTCH if k not in VERT]

# ---- conserved glutamine braces, data-driven from the 12 canonical carriers ----
qr=[]
for p,aa in enumerate(AAC,1):
    if aa!='Q': continue
    frac=float(np.mean([M[n].get(p,'-')=='Q' for n in CANON]))
    qr.append({'AAC1_uniprot':p,'AAC1_mature':p-1,'frac_Q_canonical':round(frac,2),'context':AAC[max(0,p-5):p+4]})
Q=pd.DataFrame(qr).sort_values('frac_Q_canonical',ascending=False)
print('Glutamines of bovine AAC1 ranked by conservation across 12 canonical SLC25 carriers:')
print(Q.head(10).to_string(index=False))
BRACE=[int(r.AAC1_uniprot) for r in Q.itertuples() if r.frac_Q_canonical>=0.5]
print('\nGlutamine-brace set (>=50% Q), mature numbering:',[b-1 for b in BRACE])

rows=[]
for n in CANON+VERT+INV:
    res=[M[n].get(p,'-') for p in BRACE]
    rows.append({'protein':n,'class':('canonical SLC25' if n in CANON else
                 'MTCH vertebrate' if n in VERT else 'MTCH invertebrate/basal'),
                 'braces':''.join(res),'n_Q':sum(r=='Q' for r in res)})
QB=pd.DataFrame(rows); QB['pct']=100*QB.n_Q/len(BRACE)
print('\nGlutamine-brace retention (n=%d positions):'%len(BRACE))
print(QB.to_string(index=False))
QB.to_csv('glutamine_brace_retention.csv',index=False)
import scipy.stats as st
a=QB[QB['class']=='canonical SLC25'].n_Q.values; b=QB[QB['class'].str.startswith('MTCH')].n_Q.values
u,p=st.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='greater')
print('\ncanonical %.2f +/- %.2f  vs MTCH %.2f +/- %.2f ; Mann-Whitney U=%.1f p=%.2e'%(a.mean(),a.std(),b.mean(),b.std(),u,p))

# ---- motif census incl. invertebrates, with permutation p-values ----
mrx=re.compile(r'(?=(P.[DE]..[KR]))'); cyt=re.compile(r'(?=([FY][DE]..[KR]))')
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); cen=[]
for n in CANON+VERT+INV:
    s=ALL[n]; o=len(mrx.findall(s)); oc=len(cyt.findall(s))
    arr=np.frombuffer(s.encode(),dtype='S1').copy(); nl=[]
    for _ in range(3000):
        rng.shuffle(arr); nl.append(len(mrx.findall(arr.tobytes().decode())))
    nl=np.array(nl)
    cen.append({'protein':n,'class':('canonical SLC25' if n in CANON else
                'MTCH vertebrate' if n in VERT else 'MTCH invertebrate/basal'),
                'len':len(s),'PxDxxKR':o,'null_mean':round(nl.mean(),3),
                'p_perm':round(float((nl>=o).mean()),4) if o>0 else 1.0,'FYDxxKR':oc})
C=pd.DataFrame(cen); print('\n'+C.to_string(index=False)); C.to_csv('motif_census_full.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,6))
cmap={'canonical SLC25':'#2a7f62','MTCH vertebrate':'#c0392b','MTCH invertebrate/basal':'#e08b3a'}
y=np.arange(len(C))
ax.barh(y,C.PxDxxKR,color=[cmap[c] for c in C['class']])
ax.scatter(C.null_mean,y,c='k',s=12,zorder=3,label='random expectation (composition-matched)')
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(C.protein,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel('number of matrix PX[DE]XX[KR] motifs'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Matrix salt-bridge signature motifs: present in every canonical SLC25 carrier,\nabsent from the whole MTCH clade back to Trichoplax',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
